Name: Cocoa Plant and Chocolate Cooking (JA)
Author: eorrl
Description:
This is a content pack for Json Assets that adds a cocoa plant crop and cocoa beans, as well as several chocolate-based cooking recipes. It should be unzipped directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder.

The cocoa plant will grow in spring and summer, or at any time in the greenhouse or on the island farm. The seeds become available in the spring of Year 2 from Pierre's store.

The nine chocolate recipes are: Cocoa Powder, Chocolate Bar, Brownies, Chocolate Mousse, Chocolate-covered Strawberries, Chocolate Macaroons, Hot Chocolate, Mocha, and Chocolate Milkshake. These recipes can be purchased from Gus, with different recipes becoming available in each season, and in Year 2 and 3.

Different recipes provide buffs to farming, mining, luck, speed & more! Plus, all of the recipes are giftable, and every NPC loves at least one of the new items. The gift tastes of the NPCs have been included as a txt file (titled 'NPC_tastes'). The availability of the recipes (by year and season) can be seen under the spoiler below.

Hope you enjoy! :)

- Eorrl

[spoiler]

Recipe Availability:

Cocoa Powder: All seasons, beginning in Year 2
Chocolate Bar: All seasons, beginning in Year 2
Chocolate Mousse: Spring & Summer, beginning in Year 2
Brownies: Summer & Fall, beginning in Year 2
Milkshake: Summer, beginning in Year 2
Hot Chocolate: Winter, beginning in Year 2
Chocolate-covered Strawberries: Spring, beginning in Year 3
Chocolate Macaroons: Spring & Summer,  beginning in Year 3
Mocha: Fall & Winter, beginning in Year 3

[/spoiler]
